title: Warm Spring Pancakes with Russian Twist
description: Delicious pancakes with a hint of spring and a touch of Russian culture, topped with amazake syrup.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together warm water, sugar, eggs, and unsalted butter.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until combined.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Drop the batter by 1/4 cupfuls onto the pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the pancakes warm with amazake syrup drizzled on top.
To make amazake syrup, heat amazake in a saucepan over low heat until warm and syrupy.
Serve the pancakes with a sprinkle of spring onions on top.
